name: Tank front (est.): M1A2 Abrams turret
description: Russian-attributed estimate 770 mm vs long rods for the M1A2; later SEP versions are thought to be better. Stand-in: a block of armour steel as thick as the estimated protection against long rods (RHA equivalent, line of sight). Real tank armour is secret composite; public estimates vary widely between sources - this is a rough guide, not data.
